GitHub - duobaseio/forui: Duobase's Flutter UI library

name: Forui
summary: Flutter UI widget library inspired by shadcn/ui, with themes, localization, a CLI and a visual theme designer.
description: A platform-agnostic Flutter UI library with widgets for forms (text field, select, multi select, date picker, OTP field, slider, switch), navigation (header, bottom navigation bar, sidebar, tabs, breadcrumbs) and overlays (dialog, sheet, popover, toast, tooltip). Docs cover theming, controls, localization and responsive design; a CLI and icon set ship with it.
